title: The Spectacles Vision Contradiction
description:
📄 Forensic Report #104:
Witness B (legally blind without thick glasses): 'I lost my glasses at noon, but at 10 PM in pitch darkness I clearly recognized the killer's facial mole from 100 yards away.'
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Blind without glasses + pitch darkness + 100 yards away.
solution: Witness B's vision claim is physically impossible.
